messages:
harper (DevEx): Heads-up from today's onboarding: the new nextjs-rag-agent-template trips up folks on two fronts: 1) mismatch between the JS and Python examples around idempotency; 2) streaming route defaults cause confusing hangs after an auth refresh. Attached mini-repro and suggested quick fixes.

choi (SDK): Can you paste the minimal repro and what the user sees?

harper (DevEx): Repro steps: clone examples/next-rag-agent-template, set RW_KEY in env, run dev. Trigger chat -> force a 401 on the first /api/agent call (we do this in staging by toggling the key). Observed behavior: the browser either never receives further SSE events or it shows two identical paragraphs. Logs: ```
[2026-01-12T09:03:21Z] proxy POST /api/agent -> 401 {"message":"invalid api key"}
[2026-01-12T09:03:21Z] sdk.retry: auth -> refresh token
[2026-01-12T09:03:26Z] proxy POST /api/agent -> 200 (stream)
[2026-01-12T09:03:26Z] proxy: wrote chunk id=1
[2026-01-12T09:03:26Z] proxy: wrote chunk id=2
```
Front-end sometimes gets both the partial first stream and the retried full stream -> duplicate message. Other times the EventSource hangs after the retry.

yana (Eng): Thanks. Sounds like two distinct bugs colliding: the retry wrapper replays streaming POSTs without preserving/detaching handlers, and the proxy/edge pipeline buffers partial chunks causing replayed data to be emitted twice. Which SDK version is the template pinned to?

harper (DevEx): Template package.json points at "@redwood/inference-sdk": "0.11.2". Quick workaround I tested: in the example's server proxy route set retry.maxRetries = 0 for streaming endpoints, and add an idempotency key per user session for generate/agent calls. That eliminated duplicates in staging.

choi (SDK): Agreed on the workaround. Long-term plan from the SDK side: 1) make retryer aware of streaming responses; if bytes have been emitted, treat 401/403 as non-retryable to avoid replaying partial streams; 2) add an opt-in idempotency header (Idempotency-Key) that servers can dedupe on; 3) ensure when we must replay a stream we reattach the same listeners or provide a clear error to the app. I'll open a canary PR with the streaming guard.

mike (QA): I'll add an e2e in the example harness that simulates: 401 -> 200 with partial chunk, and assert the final conversation contains only one assistant response and EventSource terminates normally. Filing QA ticket QA-1321.

lina (Docs): We'll update the starter README: short troubleshooting section for "auth + streaming" and show the recommended dev workaround: ```js
// pages/api/proxy.js (streaming route)
const client = createClient({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY, retry: { maxRetries: 0 } })
// and send an idempotency key per session
await client.agent.run({ prompt, idempotencyKey: sessionId })
```
Also add a note about parity with Python example: show the same idempotency pattern in both languages.

choi (SDK): One nuance: we don't want to disable retries wholesale for streaming because infra flakiness should still recover in many cases. So the implementation will only treat auth failures (401/403) as non-retryable if the stream has already emitted bytes; other transient codes (502/503/504) still go through retry logic. We'll also add telemetry tag 'stream_retry:dropped' so support can filter these cases.

harper (DevEx): That sounds good. For onboarding, I'd like a short checklist item: "If your chat hangs or shows duplicated paragraphs after sign-in/preview deploys -> (1) set retry.maxRetries=0 for streaming proxy routes, (2) enable idempotency keys in the agent call, (3) upgrade to SDK v0.11.3+ once canary lands." Can we add that to the quickstart?

lina (Docs): Yep, I'll add the checklist and a one-liner migration guide. Also including the little UI dedupe snippet we keep using in demos: ```js
// client-side simple dedupe: drop immediate consecutive identical assistant chunks
let last = ''
eventSource.onmessage = e => { if (e.data === last) return; last = e.data; append(e.data) }
```

mike (QA): After canary publishes, I'll run a full smoke test on the updated template and mark it green if no duplicates or hangs. CI: will pin canary in examples package.json while we validate.

choi (SDK): PR opened: github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/2062 (streaming-retry-guard + idempotency header). Cutting canary v0.11.3-canary-stream. Will post the canary NPM + preview link here when CI finishes.

ci-bot: Buildkite: #9843 passed for branch streaming-retry-guard (artifact: sdk-canary.tgz) :white_check_mark:

harper (DevEx): Verified canary in a quick smoke run: upgraded the example to the canary and the chat recovered from forced 401 without dupes. I'll update the onboarding workshop notes and de-pin the workaround once the stable release lands. Thanks all. :tada:
